findings.summary: The player falls to their death four times in a row on the opening floating-platform jumps and is blocked there for about 25 seconds before finally crossing.

evidence.visual: The small white character runs along the narrow green path and repeatedly jumps toward the small floating platform before the brown bridge, falls below it, and respawns on the path to try again.

findings.suggested_fix: Move the small floating platform closer to the take-off edge and make it twice as wide, so this first jump does not require near-perfect distance and landing.

findings.summary: The objective says "Reach the beacon," but no beacon is visible in the plaza, so the player wanders and backtracks for about 40 seconds before finding the stepped platforms that actually lead onward.

telemetry: objective_update at 30.9 s text="Reach the beacon."
evidence.visual: For about 40 seconds the character loops between the tall brown pillars and orange crates, runs into a dead-end brown wall, backtracks across the plaza, and only later reaches the stepped green platforms in a side corner. No beacon, light beam, or marker is visible on screen during the search.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a tall, glowing vertical beacon beam over the stepped green platforms at the plaza exit and change the objective text to "Reach the beacon by the stepped platforms."

findings.summary: The player does not work out for about 29 seconds that the crate, raised shelf, and red button open the way through, instead circling the room and trying the closed door directly.

telemetry: objective_update at 70.9 s text="Find a way through."
objective_update at 100.1 s text="The gate is open. Find the exit."
evidence.visual: The character circles the light-blue room several times, goes up to and jumps against the closed wooden door in the back wall, returns toward the entrance, and only around 97-100 seconds jumps from a crate onto the raised shelf and steps on the red button.

findings.suggested_fix: Make the red button pulse with a bright red glow and increase its size by half, so it stands out on the raised shelf when the player first enters the room.

findings.summary: The mushroom creature kills the player twice shortly after they drop into the room, and they only get past on the third attempt by jumping over it near the narrow exit.

evidence.visual: The character drops into the green room where the red white-spotted mushroom creature walks toward the narrow exit passage. The player collides with it and dies on the first two entries, and only passes on the third entry by jumping over it.

findings.suggested_fix: Move the mushroom creature's starting position to the far side of the room and halve its walking speed, so the player has time to see it and line up a jump after dropping in.

findings.summary: The EXIT sign at the fork points the player into a dead-end left branch, costing about 14 seconds of walking there and back before they try the other route.

evidence.visual: The player reaches the red arrow sign labelled EXIT, follows its left-pointing arrow into the left hedge path, walks to a closed dead end, turns around, and retraces the same path back to the junction before taking the other route.

findings.suggested_fix: Rotate the red arrow on the EXIT sign at this junction so it points toward the route that leads to the corridor, not toward the left dead end.

findings.summary: The final corridor is a single straight, empty run of about 40 seconds with nothing to do, decide, or avoid, so play stalls after the earlier sections.

evidence.visual: From about 149 to 189 seconds the character simply runs straight down one long green hedge corridor, passing repeated grey pillars on both sides with no turns, enemies, obstacles, or pickups, until the red flag appears at the far end.

findings.suggested_fix: Shorten the corridor by half by moving the red flag end closer to the entrance, cutting this empty run from about 40 seconds to about 20 seconds.
